title: Split a video's sound onto its own track
summary: Right-click a video clip and choose Split sound onto its own track: the sound gets a linked audio track under the picture.
alternateQueries: How do I separate the audio from a video?
How do I edit the video's sound separately?
How do I reconnect the sound to the picture?

steps.instruction: Right-click the video clip and choose Split sound onto its own track.
steps.expectedResult: The first time, the video's sound is prepared (a progress window). A new audio track appears directly under the video's track, holding the sound as a clip.

blocks.text: The picture and its sound are linked: moving, trimming or splitting one does the same to the other. Unlink picture and sound lets you slide the sound against the picture; Link picture and sound joins them again; Put sound back into the video returns the sound to the video clip.
The video's own sound plays through the track it is on, so its volume is controlled by that track in the mixer.
